question: For payment-service, which code fix is complete, which preventive work remains in progress, and is general customer release approved?

claims.text: The PAY-102 code fix is Done.

supports.quote: PAY-102 code fix: Done. Code completion does not approve general customer release.

claims.text: PAY-103 protective measures are In Progress.

supports.quote: PAY-103 protective measures: In Progress. Owner: Maya.

claims.text: General availability (GA) is not approved, so general customer release is not approved; the release decision approved a controlled pilot, and PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval.

supports.quote: Release decision: controlled pilot approved. General availability (GA) not approved. PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval.
